column3:
Presence of promoter-associated marks H3K4me3 and H3K9ac. Highly enriched at
transcription start sites (TSSs)

Presence of promoter-associated marks H3K4me3 and H3K9ac, but at lower levels
than Promoters. Tends to occur upstream or downstream of TSSs
Presence of the enhancer-associated marks H3K27ac and H3K4me1.
Same as Enhancer, but with lower signal values.
Presence of both activating (H3K27ac) and repressive (H3K27me3) marks. Thought to mark regulatory elements “poised” for activation.
Presence of the transcription factor CTCF, thought to play a role in chromatin conformation. In samples without measured CTCF, this label marks positions with CTCF-associated marks
Characterized by the transcription-associated mark H3K36me3. Highly enriched in annotated gene bodies.
Presence of the marks H3K9me3 and H3K36me3, a pattern associated with zinc finger genes.
Facultative (Polycomb) Heterochromatin, characterized by the histone modification H3K27me3. Thought to carry out cell type-specific repression
Constitutive Heterochromatin, characterized by the histone modification H3K9me3. Marks permanently silent regions such as centromeres and telomeres.
